lastUserInput: This is a read-only capture workload. Launch exactly two research subagents in parallel in a single turn using invoke_subagent: subagent 1 (Role: "Alpha Runner") must run pwd using run_command and report the output; subagent 2 (Role: "Beta Reader") must read lines 1-3 of README.md using read_file and report the first heading. Wait for both subagents to reply, then return both results. Do not edit files.
